Product Features

  • Rattan elegance redefined: Elevate your interior design with a fascinating sideboard that adorns three doors with a tasteful rattan weave.
  • Versatile storage, endless possibilities: Experience organization with three spacious compartments that can accommodate various items and keep your space tidy.
  • Crafted for Durability: Cleverly crafted from high-quality rattan and sturdy wood, this piece of furniture ensures reliability and longevity.
  • Versatile storage: This sideboard has adjustable shelves and offers customizable storage space to suit your needs. Easily organize and present your items.
  • Effortless Assembly Experience: Clear assembly instructions and included accessories simplify the setup process and allow you to enjoy your new rattan sideboard without stress. This product is packaged in two. You can get it on different days.
  • Applicable for various scenarios- With practical functions and appealing appearance, the sideboard is a good addition to the kitchen, dining room, living room, bedroom or hallway. Please note that there may be color deviations due to different lighting conditions and monitors!
  • Sufficient storage space and showroom-The sideboard with 3 doors increases the storage capacity and the storage space for everyday necessities such as books, clothes, etc. The cabinet top is a perfect platform for storing lamps, photos and decorations.
  • Elegant Design - With its walnut brown chipboard, the sideboard looks elegant and modern, adding an elegant touch to any room. This TV set is perfect as a decoration and storage for your space. The rustic style makes it suitable for all your other furniture.
  • Practical metal legs-The 15 cm high metal legs of the sideboard facilitate daily storage and prevent annoying dusting underneath. This product will be shipped in 2 packages, the arrival time may be different, please be patient. If parts are missing, please contact customer service.
  • The chest of drawers is quick and easy to assemble thanks to the detailed instructions, making it suitable for beginners. The mounting material is included. Dimensions: 129.8x 40x 76cm (W/H/D), net weight: 34.05 kg. Total load capacity: 70kg.
